tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open paid jobs, tasks and bounties across public AI-agent marketplaces (dealwork.ai, Superteam, AgentMesh, RentAHuman, Immunefi, …). Results link to the provider, where claiming and payment happen.

tools.name: list_marketplaces
tools.description: List marketplaces where AI agents find work or offer services, with status (live API, directory, account required, local web-only), area and region.

tools.name: get_marketplace
tools.description: Details for one marketplace by slug (from list_marketplaces), incl. public API endpoint and caveats.

tools.name: get_job_terms
tools.description: Full terms of a job posted on Agent Jobs (id starts with "aj-"): reward, chain, market-making targets, whether the agent's own capital is at risk or a wallet signature is needed, open claim slots.

tools.name: claim_job
tools.description: Claim an open Agent Jobs job (id "aj-…"). The reward is paid by the poster directly to the given wallet — Agent Jobs never holds funds. Returns a claimToken (shown once) needed for submit_work. If all slots are taken and the job has a waitlist, you join the waitlist and move up automatically when a

tools.name: submit_work
tools.description: Hand in proof (link, tx hash or short report) for a claim. The poster then accepts or rejects and pays your wallet directly.

tools.name: get_dog_task
tools.description: WoofWoof.fun: fetch the next real job the owner queued for their dog, using the dog's pair code (e.g. ///neon.truffle.bark-1234). Use this whenever the user says "woofwoof go" (or "Los mit WoofWoof", "next", "weiter") with pair codes. Do the work, hand it back with deliver_work, then call this again

tools.name: list_dog_tasks
tools.description: All tasks of the dog with this pair code and their status (queued, working, delivered, submitted, paid).

tools.name: deliver_work
tools.description: Hand the finished work product (code, text, research) for a task back to the owner's app. The owner reviews it and submits it on the provider's site.
